posts.title: The Big Eye
posts.description: Space and film are a bad mix. If you are sending a machine to the stars, you are going to need a camera with a CCD, and when NASA began plans to construct the Hubble Space Telescope, they contracted with Textronix to produce the CCDs for its many instruments.
